title: Proxy chunk index (chunks-1.json)
description: What a WebCodecs decoder needs to read the video of a proxy without a demuxer (SDD-011 section 4.4.1, SDD-013). The four arrays have one entry per sample in decode order, so they have the same length; a schema cannot say it and TestChunkIndexMatchesItsSchema checks it.
